title: Eleventy author metadata migration decomposition
task_summary: Partition a broad content/build migration by compatible working states rather than files and phases.

project.name: Eleventy author metadata migration fixture
project.kind: static content site and authoring tooling

approved_outcomes.outcome: Legacy single-author and structured one-or-more-author metadata normalize to one documented internal representation during migration.
Pages, archives, feeds, and metadata render equivalent single-author behavior and approved multi-author behavior from the normalized model.
Content and authoring tools migrate safely to the structured form.
Legacy form is retired only after no maintained source or generated surface depends on it.
Every intermediate revision builds and publishes valid output.

coherent_deliverables.title: Introduce dual-format normalization and compatibility
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: The site can safely accept old and new content before consumers or content migrate.

coherent_deliverables.title: Move generated surfaces to the normalized model
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: All public output uses one stable internal representation while both source formats remain valid.

coherent_deliverables.title: Migrate content and authoring tools
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: Maintained producers and content stop creating new legacy dependencies.

coherent_deliverables.title: Retire the legacy author form after evidence
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: The migration completes only after direct content and generated-output evidence makes removal safe.

acceptable_alternatives: Combine normalization and generated-surface adoption when a clear dual-format working state remains.
Split content migration only for independently owned content collections.
fragmentation_examples: Parser and schema tasks separated from compatibility delivery.
Page, archive, and feed templates each becoming a task.
Content rewrite and authoring helper updates split without ownership.
Unit tests, build tests, documentation, cleanup, and final review as horizontal tasks.
overpacking_examples: One atomic change across content, normalization, templates, feeds, tooling, and rejection removes the safe compatibility window.
important_crossings: Real front matter flows through normalization and the production Eleventy build into pages, archives, and feeds at every migration state.
open_questions: Stable author identifier format and legacy deprecation period require approval.

handoff.retain_plan: Preserve working migration states, rollback assumptions, dependencies, and direct retirement evidence.
handoff.omit_plan: Preserve current consumers/producers, compatibility constraints, public questions, and source pointers without the four-stage migration direction.
handoff.fresh_agent_plan: A fresh agent reconstructs compatible working states and does not create a task per surface or test type.
